constraints: explicit dry-run over one validated COMPLETE lease-set observation
separate minimum ages for released and expired history
maximum 10000 exact candidates with deferred-count disclosure
planning has no source-removal authority
requires explicit application plus the exact sealed proposal digest
proposal shape, policy derivation, candidate ordering, counts, and authority are validated
approval is bound to the observed cache-root fingerprint
no daemon, scheduler, background polling, or automatic curation
ACTIVE leases are never candidates
each candidate is rechecked under the same per-lease lifecycle lock used by acquire, protect, and release
busy coordination and changed tails remove no source segment
only exact released or policy-aged expired live segments can apply
complete original JSONL bytes are gzip-compressed with sealed raw and compressed digests
source removal follows durable blob, chained receipt, and hot anchor publication
cold segments remain append-only and are never automatic deletion candidates
one small sealed anchor retains owner, exact tail event, semantic history count, archive count, and latest receipt link
routine discovery reads the anchor, latest receipt, and blob shape rather than every historical event
tail digest, generation, state, and key-set discovery semantics remain unchanged
no latency or throughput improvement is claimed
an anchor plus its still-present exact source segment is an explicit REVIEW_REQUIRED compaction window
reapplying the same approved proposal removes only that already archived source
exact blob and receipt writes are conflict-detecting and reusable after a retry
fresh child process continues generation after a released anchor with a new ACQUIRED event
fresh child process renews an expired anchor and restores its prior protected key set
continued live events can be archived as the next independently sealed cold segment
separate explicit audit has anchor, segment, compressed-byte, and raw-byte ceilings
audit walks every receipt, rehashes and decompresses every blob, validates the complete event transition chain, and reconstructs predecessor anchors
missing blobs, same-size corruption, false predecessor links, cycles, and exceeded ceilings fail closed
sealed derived receipts expose root, owner, source, and locator digests rather than local paths or raw run identifiers
routine hot discovery does not claim full historical cold-blob integrity
cold archive retention, rollup, scheduling, cross-host coordination, authentication, native game execution, promotion, and CANON remain outside this capability
